items.title: Bob Cranshaw interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: we have the Lincoln Center Orchestra with Wynton Marsalis, we already got their group involved with the union

ctx.x: Well I mean I’m moving, but I understand, because of the business. So now, talking to younger players, right now I’m working with the union now to get into something else. Because they’re not involved in Broadway shows, because they’re not involved with the symphonies and the things that are already plugged into the musician’s union. I’m trying to see if I can help the union find ways to plug the jazz musicians and the rock musicians into the mainstream so that we don’t have to do benefits for a guy when he…
angry at the union for what they don’t do, I’m a part of the union. So when they talk about the union they’re also talking about me. I’m the part that they’re talking about.
